rationale: The three most recent 1-minute candles printed 41k-72k shares each on net upward closes after two low-volume downticks of only a few hundred shares, driving price off the 27.14 low and through the developing 9-EMA. This volume asymmetry and holding action above the short-term average supply the long thesis; a break of 27.48 would invalidate the observed absorption.
